captureMethod: RenderTargetBitmap of visible production WPF windows
interaction: All embedded topics and images, four themes and two window sizes; stage11-input waits for external OS input in isolated fixture windows. See stage11 reports.
limitations: RenderTargetBitmap at 144/192 DPI is raster-density coverage, not an OS monitor/DPI transition. Computer Use SendInput is recorded separately and is not a human physical key press. No user profile, clipboard, device, model or network access.
